
## Load the libraries
```{r}
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(viridisLite)
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(spData) # spatial data
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(geodata) # spatial data
library(stars)
```

## Load the data
```{r}
roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
# Reading in highways data
highways <- st_read("EDS223-HW4/data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg", query=roads_query) # vector

#Load houses data 
# Query for certain buildings
houses_query <- "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"
# Reading in houses data
houses <- st_read("EDS223-HW4/data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg", query=houses_query) # vector

feb_07_h5 <- read_stars('EDS223-HW4/data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
feb_07_h6 <- read_stars('EDS223-HW4/data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')

feb_16_h5 <- read_stars('EDS223-HW4/data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
feb_16_h6 <- read_stars('EDS223-HW4/data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif') 
```

## Check that CRS match
```{r}
cat("\n=== Same CRS? ===\n")
cat("highways vs houses: ", same.crs(highways, houses), "\n")
cat("highways vs feb_07_h5: ", same.crs(highways, feb_07_h5), "\n")
cat("feb_07_h5 vs feb_16_h6: ", same.crs(feb_07_h5, feb_16_h6), "\n")
```

## Merge tiles together to create a 07 February 2021 tile and a 16 February 2021 tile.
```{r}
houston_post_storm <- st_mosaic(feb_16_h5, feb_16_h6)

houston_pre_storm <- st_mosaic(feb_07_h5,feb_07_h6)
```
```{r}
if(all(st_bbox(houston_pre_storm) == st_bbox(houston_post_storm))){
  print("extents match")
} else{
  print("warning: extents do not match")
}
```

```{r}
houston_diff <- rast(houston_pre_storm) - rast(houston_post_storm)
```
```{r}
blackout_mask <- classify(houston_diff, matrix(
    c(-Inf, 200, NA, # No blackout
    200, Inf, 1   # Blackout
),
ncol = 3,
byrow = TRUE))
```

```{r}
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29,
xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
crs = st_crs(feb_07_h5))
```

```{r}
blackout_vectorised <- st_as_stars(blackout_mask) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    st_make_valid()
blackout_houston <- st_crop(blackout_vectorised, houston_bbox) |> 
    st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:3038')
```

```{r}
pre_crop <- st_crop(houston_pre_storm, houston_bbox)
post_crop <- st_crop(houston_post_storm, houston_bbox)
light_combined <- c(pre_crop, post_crop)
names(light_combined) <- c("07-02-2021", "16-02-2021")
lights <- merge(light_combined)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(lights) +
tm_raster(
col.scale = tm_scale_continuous_log1p(values = "magma"),
col.legend = tm_legend(
title = "Night light radiance (nW/cm²/sr)",
orientation = "landscape"
)
) +
tm_title("Houston Night Time Light Intensity Before and After February 2021 Storms") +
tm_compass(position = c("right", "bottom"), size = 0.5) +
tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"))
```
```{r}
highways <- st_transform(highways, crs = 'EPSG:3038')
highway_buffer <- highways |>
st_union() |>
st_buffer(dist = 200)
```

```{r}
blackout_houston <- st_transform(blackout_houston, crs = 'EPSG:3038')
```
```{r}
blackout_final <- st_difference(blackout_houston, highway_buffer)
blackout_houses <- st_transform(houses, crs = 'EPSG:3038') |>
    st_filter(blackout_final)
n_blackout_houses <- nrow(blackout_houses) #  houses
```

```{r}
tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap.HOT") + 
  tm_shape(blackout_houses) + # Homes where power was lost
  tm_polygons(size = 0.05, fill = "grey", fill_alpha = 0.7) +
  tm_add_legend(labels = 'Blackout Areas', position = c("bottom", "right")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("bottom", "left")) + # Add scalebar and compass
  tm_compass(position = c("top", "right")) +
  tm_title("Homes In Houston That Experienced Power Outages, February 2021")
```
